description: This file defines the class 'tlAttachment', a helper class used within the TestLink project to manage attachments associated with various entities. It includes methods for creating, reading, and deleting attachment metadata from the database, as well as managing file contents and properties.

classes.name: tlAttachment
classes.description: Helper class for managing attachment metadata, including creation, reading from database, and deletion of attachments.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes the attachment object with specified parameters, including metadata and file contents.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Reads attachment metadata from the database using the provided database connection.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns a legacy array with the attachment's metadata information.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Writes the attachment's metadata and content into the database.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the attachment entry from the database.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment object from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Stub method intended to retrieve multiple attachments by their IDs (not implemented).

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Stub method intended to retrieve all attachments with optional filtering (not implemented).
